policy.name: student-template-public-forks-v1-normal
policy.description: Bounded public quiet double threats with executable one-turn capture followthrough.
policy.model: Unchanged honest opening-template Flag/Bomb posterior and native ranked search. Quiet moves only: a public double threat against disclosed mobile victims must have a positive short material-conversion certificate strictly exceeding the native common control. Universal count-feasible enemy public replies, one disclosed surviving friendly capture, universal second enemy replies. Fixed root material worth includes collateral losses and Flag/immobility counterwins. A transient exact-public-successor witness executes the certified fork-actor capture next turn; immediate Flag wins take priority. All candidate and control proofs share a20000enemy-outcome cap; incomplete proofs fall back. One native search per turn, no extra RNG; actual selection repairs native history. Python research prototype, no CX16 cost qualification.
policy.information_model: Own army, public revealed ranks/movement/captures/counts and source-informed population prior only. Proof branches use count-feasible hidden support without consulting actual enemy identities. No opponent setup, referee truth, deployment seed or private RNG.

scope: Portable integration, no counterfactual strength claim.
